senses.definition: a small magical being with wings, found in stories
senses.definitionCN: 故事中长着翅膀的魔法小人
senses.example: A fairy appeared at the window.
senses.exampleCN: 一个仙女出现在窗前。
senses.why: The core sense is the tiny enchanted figure.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是那个小小的魔法形象。

senses.title: Magical or imaginary
senses.definition: used before a noun to mean magical or imaginary
senses.definitionCN: 置于名词前，表示魔幻或想象中的
senses.example: She told a fairy story about a talking fish.
senses.exampleCN: 她讲了一个会说话的鱼的童话。
senses.why: The being's world becomes an adjective for enchantment.
senses.whyCN: 仙女的世界成为表示魔幻的形容词。

senses.title: A pleasing untruth
senses.definition: an informal term for a story that is pleasant but untrue
senses.definitionCN: 非正式用语，指好听却不真实的说辞
senses.example: He told them a fairy story about the missing money.
senses.exampleCN: 他给他们编了一套关于丢失钱款的好听说辞。
senses.why: A tale too lovely to be true becomes a cover story.
senses.whyCN: 美得不可信的故事变成了掩饰之辞。

intro.en: Fairy comes from Old French faerie, enchantment, from fae, a fairy, from Latin fata, the fates.
intro.cn: fairy 来自古法语 faerie（魔法），源头 fae（仙女），再上溯拉丁语 fata（命运女神）。

items.en: Fata means the fates or destiny.
items.cn: fata 意为命运女神或命运。

items.en: Fae means a fairy or enchantress.
items.cn: fae 意为仙女或女巫。

items.en: Faerie means enchantment or fairyland.
items.cn: faerie 意为魔法或仙境。

items.en: Fairie enters English as a magical realm.
items.cn: fairie 以魔法之境进入英语。

items.en: Fairy comes to mean the little being itself.
items.cn: 现代英语中 fairy 转为指小精灵本身。

note.en: A fairy is magical; a ferry is a boat.
note.cn: fairy 是仙女，ferry 则是渡船。

entries.definition: a boat that carries people across water

normalIntro.en: Fairy names the little magical being and the enchanted world around her.
normalIntro.cn: fairy 指魔法小人，也指她周围的魔法世界。

normal.en: The tooth fairy left a coin under the pillow.
normal.cn: 牙仙子在枕头下留了一枚硬币。

normal.en: The children dressed as fairies for the play.
normal.cn: 孩子们在剧中打扮成仙女。

normal.en: She loves old fairy tales.
normal.cn: 她喜欢古老的童话。

normal.en: Fairy lights hung across the garden.
normal.cn: 花园里挂着小彩灯。

normal.en: The story of the lost key was a fairy tale.
normal.cn: 关于丢钥匙的说法是个编造的漂亮故事。

abstract.en: Picture a tiny figure standing on a mushroom.
abstract.cn: 想象一个小人站在蘑菇上。

abstract.en: Imagine a ring of mushrooms in the grass.
abstract.cn: 想象草地上一圈蘑菇。

abstract.en: Think of a promise too pretty to be true.
abstract.cn: 把一个美得不可信的承诺想成童话。

examples.en: The fairy in the story grants three wishes.
examples.cn: 故事里的仙女实现三个愿望。

examples.en: They decorated the tree with fairy lights.
examples.cn: 他们用小彩灯装饰圣诞树。

examples.en: He gave a fairy story to explain his absence.
examples.cn: 他编了一套好听说辞来解释缺席。

dict_mnemonic.note: 词源记忆 · 拉丁命运
dict_mnemonic.text: fairy 与 fate 同源于拉丁语 fata（命运女神），掌管命运的女神逐渐变成了故事里的仙女。

root: fairy 经由古法语 faerie 来自拉丁语 fata（命运女神），由「掌管命运者」演变为魔法小精灵。

sensesIntro.en: Fairy is a magical being, an adjective for enchantment, or an informal word for a pretty lie.
sensesIntro.cn: fairy 指魔法小人、表示魔幻的形容词，或非正式意义上的漂亮谎言。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a tiny winged figure stepping out of a tale.
core.cn: 核心意象：从故事里走出的小小带翅身影。

branches.en: The base sense is the magical being.
branches.cn: 基础义是魔法小人。

branches.en: Her world becomes an adjective for magic.
branches.cn: 她的世界成为表示魔法的形容词。

branches.en: A lovely tale becomes a cover story.
branches.cn: 美丽故事变成掩饰之辞。

branches.en: The being and the enchanted world belong together.
branches.cn: 仙女与魔法世界彼此相依。

branches.en: Both describe something unreal but appealing.
branches.cn: 两者都描述不真实却迷人的东西。

intro.en: Fairy builds compounds for storybook beings and enchanted places.
intro.cn: fairy 构成指故事人物与魔法场所的复合词。

latinIntro.en: Latin fata, the fates, is the distant source of fairy and fate.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 fata（命运女神）是 fairy 与 fate 的远源。

items.example: The fairies danced in the moonlight.
Cinderella is a famous fairy tale.
Her fairy godmother gave her a dress.
items.exampleCN: 她的仙女教母给了她一条裙子。

items.meaning: a fairy said to take lost teeth

items.example: They hung fairy lights on the balcony.
items.exampleCN: 他们在阳台上挂了小彩灯。

items.meaning: a ring of mushrooms in grass
items.example: A fairy ring appeared after the rain.
items.exampleCN: 雨后草地上出现了一圈蘑菇。

items.meaning: a fairy tale or an untrue excuse
items.exampleCN: 没人相信他编的漂亮故事。

latinEntries.example: Fata is the distant root of fairy.
latinEntries.exampleCN: fata 是 fairy 的远源。

definition_zh: 围住；把…封入；随信附上
definition_en: to surround something with a boundary, or to put something inside an envelope or container
core_image: 木栅栏把花园围成一个安稳的小世界
scene: 农场用木栅栏围住羊群。 The farm encloses the sheep with a wooden fence.
sceneCN: 这里 enclose 是「围住」（第 1 个义项：用边界把某物围起来）；句意：农场用木栅栏围住羊群。

derivatives.zh: 围场；围栏；附件
随信附上的；封闭的

senses.title: To surround with a boundary
senses.definition: to put a wall, fence, or other boundary around an area
senses.definitionCN: 用墙、栅栏或其他边界把一片区域围起来
senses.example: A fence encloses the garden.
senses.exampleCN: 一道栅栏把花园围了起来。
senses.why: The prefix en- suggests putting something inside, and a boundary keeps it there.
senses.whyCN: 前缀 en- 暗示把某物放入其中，而边界把它留在里面。

senses.title: To put something inside an envelope
senses.definition: to include something inside a letter or package
senses.definitionCN: 把某物放入信件或包裹中一起寄出
senses.example: Please enclose a copy of your passport.
senses.exampleCN: 请随信附上护照复印件。
senses.why: A letter is a container in transit, so putting a document inside is a form of enclosing.
senses.whyCN: 信件是运输中的容器，因此把文件放进去就是一种封入。

senses.title: To contain or seal something in
senses.definition: to shut something inside a container or space
senses.definitionCN: 把某物关在容器或空间内部
senses.example: The seeds are enclosed in a hard shell.
senses.exampleCN: 种子被封在坚硬的壳里。
senses.why: The core idea is being inside a boundary, whether fence, envelope, or shell.
senses.whyCN: 核心概念是被边界包在里面，无论是栅栏、信封还是外壳。

intro.en: Enclose comes from Old French enclore, built on the Latin root claudere, to shut.
intro.cn: enclose 来自古法语 enclore，建立在拉丁词根 claudere（关闭）之上。

items.en: Claudere means to shut or close.
items.cn: claudere 意为关闭。

items.en: Enclore means to shut in or surround.
items.cn: enclore 意为关在里面、围住。

items.en: English borrows the verb as enclose or inclose.
items.cn: 英语借入时写作 enclose 或 inclose。

items.en: The spelling enclose becomes standard.
items.cn: 拼写 enclose 成为标准。

items.en: The word covers fences, envelopes, and sealed spaces.
items.cn: 现代英语中，这个词涵盖栅栏、信封和封闭空间。

note.en: Enclose surrounds or seals in; surround is wider, and attach means adding something to a message.
note.cn: enclose 围住或封入，surround 范围更广，attach 指把某物附加到消息中。

entries.definitionCN: 围住；附上（第三人称单数）

entries.definition: an enclosed area or an item sent with a letter
to join something to a message or file

normalIntro.en: Enclose means to put something inside a boundary, an envelope, or a shell.
normalIntro.cn: enclose 意为把某物放入边界、信封或外壳之中。

normal.en: A fence encloses the field.
normal.cn: 栅栏把田地围住。

normal.en: Please enclose your photo.
normal.cn: 请随信附上照片。

normal.en: The seeds are enclosed in a shell.
normal.cn: 种子被包在壳里。

normal.en: An enclosure is an enclosed space.
normal.cn: enclosure 是被围起来的空间。

normal.en: The enclosed garden is private.
normal.cn: 被围住的花园是私人的。

abstract.en: Picture a fence drawing a circle around green grass.
abstract.cn: 想象栅栏在绿草周围画出一个圈。

abstract.en: See a letter folded around a small photograph.
abstract.cn: 想象信纸包住一张小照片。

abstract.en: Think of a seed sleeping inside a hard shell.
abstract.cn: 想象种子睡在坚硬的外壳里。

examples.en: A fence encloses the garden.
examples.cn: 一道栅栏把花园围了起来。

examples.en: Please enclose a copy of your passport.
examples.cn: 请随信附上护照复印件。

examples.en: The seeds are enclosed in a hard shell.
examples.cn: 种子被封在坚硬的壳里。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「因克洛斯」——把东西「克」制在里面、关起来；只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 古法语 enclore，建立在拉丁语 claudere（关闭）的词根上。

sensesIntro.en: The word covers boundaries, items sent in letters, and spaces sealed by shells or walls.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个词涵盖边界、随信附上的物品，以及被外壳或墙壁封闭的空间。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a fence making a safe circle on open ground.
core.cn: 核心意象：栅栏在空地上围出安全的圆圈。

branches.en: The base sense is surrounding an area with a boundary.
branches.cn: 基本义是用边界围住一片区域。

branches.en: A letter becomes a container for an enclosed item.
branches.cn: 信件成为所附物品的容器。

branches.en: Any boundary that seals something inside fits the image.
branches.cn: 任何把东西封在里面的边界都符合这一意象。

branches.en: Fences and shells both keep an inside apart.
branches.cn: 栅栏与外壳都把内部隔开。

branches.en: The envelope and the shell are both enclosures.
branches.cn: 信封与外壳都是封闭物。

intro.en: Enclose joins en-, meaning in, with the Latin root claud, meaning to shut.
intro.cn: enclose 把意为「在内」的 en- 与意为关闭的拉丁词根 claud 结合。

latinIntro.en: The root claudere, to shut, also appears in include and exclude.
latinIntro.cn: 意为关闭的词根 claudere 也出现在 include 与 exclude 中。

items.example: The prefix en- puts something inside.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 en- 把某物放入其中。

items.example: The root claud- hides inside enclose.
items.exampleCN: 词根 claud- 藏在 enclose 里。
enclosing 标记正在进行的动作。

items.example: Include also means to shut in.
Exclude is the opposite of include.
items.exampleCN: exclude 是 include 的反面。

items.example: Close and enclose share one idea.
items.exampleCN: close 与 enclose 共享一个概念。

definition_zh: 严厉的；恶劣的；刺耳的；粗糙的
definition_en: unkind and severe, unpleasantly rough, or hard to live in
core_image: 砂纸般粗糙的表面划过指尖
scene: 冬天的风很刺骨。 The winter wind was harsh.
sceneCN: 这里 harsh 是「恶劣的」（第 2 个义项）；句意：冬天的风很刺骨。

derivatives.zh: 严厉地；粗糙地
严厉；严酷

senses.title: Unkind and severe
senses.definition: cruel or unkind in words or treatment
senses.definitionCN: 言语或对待方式残酷、不仁慈
senses.example: He spoke in harsh words.
senses.exampleCN: 他说话很严厉。
senses.why: This is the social sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是人际层面的义项。

senses.title: Hard to live in
senses.definition: severe and difficult, as weather or conditions
senses.definitionCN: 指天气或条件严酷艰难
senses.example: The winter wind was harsh.
senses.exampleCN: 冬天的风很刺骨。
senses.why: A severe manner and severe weather share one word.
senses.whyCN: 严厉的态度与严酷的天气，共用一个词。

senses.title: Unpleasant to sense
senses.definition: unpleasantly strong or rough to hear or see
senses.definitionCN: 听或看时令人不适的强烈粗糙
senses.example: The harsh light hurt my eyes.
senses.exampleCN: 刺眼的光让我眼睛疼。
senses.why: Roughness is felt by the ear and the eye.
senses.whyCN: 粗糙也能被耳朵和眼睛感到。

senses.title: Rough to touch
senses.definition: rough and unpleasant to touch
senses.definitionCN: 触感粗粝不适
senses.example: The cloth felt harsh on the skin.
senses.exampleCN: 这布料贴在皮肤上很粗。
senses.why: This is the original texture sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是最初的质地义项。

intro.en: Harsh probably comes from a Germanic root meaning rough or hairy.
intro.cn: harsh 可能来自意为粗糙、多毛的日耳曼语词根。

items.en: The root meant rough or hairy.
items.cn: 该词根意为粗糙或多毛。

items.en: Harsk described a rough surface.
items.cn: harsk 描述粗糙的表面。

items.en: Harsh described rough weather.
items.cn: harsh 描述恶劣的天气。

items.en: It also named severe words.
items.cn: 它也指严厉的言语。

items.en: It spread to light and sound.
items.cn: 它扩展到光线与声音。

note.en: Harsh is compared with look-alike words and with words for severity and roughness.
note.cn: 把 harsh 与形近词以及表示严厉和粗糙的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Harsh is a hand on sandpaper, a wind in a bare field, and a voice with no soft edge.
normalIntro.cn: harsh 是摸到砂纸的手，是刮过荒田的风，也是没有软边的声音。

normal.en: The judge gave a harsh punishment.
normal.cn: 法官判得很严厉。

normal.en: They live in harsh conditions.
normal.cn: 他们生活在恶劣的条件下。

normal.en: The harsh light washed out the photo.
normal.cn: 刺眼的光让照片失去层次。

normal.en: Do not use harsh words.
normal.cn: 不要说刻薄的话。

normal.en: The cloth is harsh to the touch.
normal.cn: 这布料摸起来很粗。

abstract.en: What is rough teaches the skin its limits.
abstract.cn: 粗糙的东西，教会皮肤它的极限。

abstract.en: A harsh word outlives its speaker's mood.
abstract.cn: 一句刻薄话，会比说话人的情绪活得久。

abstract.en: Hard conditions do not excuse hard hearts.
abstract.cn: 艰难的处境，不能为冷酷开脱。

examples.en: The winter wind was harsh.
examples.cn: 冬天的风很刺骨。

examples.en: He spoke in harsh words.
examples.cn: 他说话很严厉。

examples.en: The harsh light hurt my eyes.
examples.cn: 刺眼的光让我眼睛疼。

dict_mnemonic.text: harsh 本指触感「粗糙」，引申为言语「严厉」、天气条件「恶劣」、光线声音「刺耳刺眼」；harsh words 是严厉的话，harsh conditions 是恶劣的条件。

root: 可能来自意为粗糙、多毛的日耳曼语词根；由触觉上的粗粝，引申为言语的严厉、环境的严酷与感官上的刺人。

sensesIntro.en: Harsh describes unkind words, severe conditions, senses that sting, or a surface that scratches.
sensesIntro.cn: harsh 描述刻薄的话、严酷的条件、刺人的感官刺激，或刮手的表面。

core.en: A surface that scrapes the skin.
core.cn: 刮着皮肤的表面。

branches.en: A judge speaks without softening a word.
branches.cn: 法官说话一句也不软。

branches.en: Wind crosses a field with no shelter.
branches.cn: 风刮过没有遮挡的田野。

branches.en: Noon light makes everyone squint.
branches.cn: 正午的光让所有人眯眼。

branches.en: A hand pulls back from rough cloth.
branches.cn: 手从粗布上缩回。

branches.en: A hard climate can make hard manners.
branches.cn: 严酷的气候，会造出严厉的举止。

intro.en: Harsh takes comparison and builds an adverb and a noun.
intro.cn: harsh 加比较级，并构成副词与名词。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root; the word is Germanic.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁词根，属于日耳曼语来源。

items.example: The harshness of the sun surprised us.
items.exampleCN: 阳光的强烈让我们吃惊。
这个计划遭到严厉批评。

definition_zh: 居住；存在于
definition_en: to live in a particular place, or to exist in something
core_image: 一栋房子门口钉着姓名牌，人长期住在里面
scene: 他在这条街住了二十年，却很少和邻居来往。 He has resided on this street for twenty years but rarely speaks to his neighbours.
sceneCN: 这里 reside 是「居住」（第 1 个义项：长期住在某处）；句意：他在这条街住了二十年，却很少和邻居来往。

derivatives.zh: 住宅；居住
居民；住户
住宅的

senses.title: To live in a place
senses.definition: to live in a particular place for a long time
senses.definitionCN: 长期住在某个地方
senses.example: He has resided on this street for twenty years.
senses.exampleCN: 他在这条街住了二十年。
senses.why: The Latin verb means to remain behind, which becomes settling and living somewhere.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁动词意为「留在后面」，由此变成定居与居住。

senses.title: To exist in something
senses.definition: to be present as a quality or power in something
senses.definitionCN: 作为性质或力量存在于某物之中
senses.example: The value of the plan resides in its simplicity.
senses.exampleCN: 这项计划的价值在于它的简洁。
senses.why: A quality can be pictured as living inside the thing that shows it.
senses.whyCN: 一种性质可以被想象成住在展现它的那个事物里面。

senses.title: To be vested in someone
senses.definition: to belong to a person or body as a right or power
senses.definitionCN: 作为权利或权力归属于某人或机构
senses.example: Supreme power resides with the people.
senses.exampleCN: 最高权力属于人民。
senses.why: Power is thought of as dwelling in the body that holds it.
senses.whyCN: 权力被看作居住在掌握它的机构之中。

intro.en: Reside comes from Latin residere, to remain behind or settle, from re- and sedere, to sit.
intro.cn: reside 来自拉丁语 residere（留下、定居），由 re- 与 sedere（坐）构成。

items.en: Sedere means to sit.
items.cn: sedere 意为坐。

items.en: Residere means to remain behind or settle.
items.cn: residere 意为留在后面、定居。

items.en: Resider means to stay or dwell.
items.cn: resider 意为停留、居住。

items.en: Middle English residen means to dwell in a place.
items.cn: 中古英语 residen 意为在某地居住。

items.en: Reside is used for a person's fixed home.
items.cn: 到 15 世纪，reside 用于指人的固定住所。

items.en: Modern English adds the sense of a quality residing in something.
items.cn: 现代英语增加了「性质存在于某物中」的义项。

note.en: Reside is a settling verb, and it sits near its noun family and near verbs for living and staying.
note.cn: reside 是一个「定居」动词，与名词词族以及表示居住和停留的动词相邻。

entries.definition: a home or the fact of living somewhere
a person who lives in a place
to have your home in a place
to live in a place, often literary
to remain in a place for a time

normalIntro.en: Reside contains Latin sedere, to sit: to reside is to settle and stay.
normalIntro.cn: reside 含有拉丁语 sedere（坐）：居住就是安顿下来、留下来。

normal.en: Re- suggests staying in place, and sedere means sit.
normal.cn: re- 暗示留在原处，sedere 表示坐。

normal.en: Reside in a place is a formal way to say live there.
normal.cn: reside in a place 是「住在那里」的正式说法。

normal.en: The power to decide resides with the committee.
normal.cn: 决定权属于委员会。

normal.en: Residence and resident both grow from this verb.
normal.cn: residence 与 resident 都从这个动词生长出来。

normal.en: Compare live: live is everyday, while reside is formal.
normal.cn: 对比 live：live 是日常用语，reside 更正式。

abstract.en: Picture a nameplate fixed beside a door for years.
abstract.cn: 想象门边挂着一块多年的姓名牌。

abstract.en: Imagine roots spreading under a house.
abstract.cn: 想象树根在一座房子下面延伸。

abstract.en: Think of a thought living quietly inside a plan.
abstract.cn: 想象一个想法安静地住在一项计划里。

examples.en: He has resided on this street for twenty years.
examples.cn: 他在这条街住了二十年。

examples.en: The value of the plan resides in its simplicity.
examples.cn: 这项计划的价值在于它的简洁。

examples.en: Supreme power resides with the people.
examples.cn: 最高权力属于人民。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「re + side」——一直待在这一边住下，就是居住；这只是构词联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 sedere（坐）→ residere（留下、定居）→ 古法语 resider → 中古英语 residen → 现代英语 reside。

sensesIntro.en: The verb begins with the image of sitting down and staying, then extends to qualities that live inside things and powers that belong to a body.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个动词从「坐下并留下」的画面开始，再扩展到「住在事物内部」的性质，以及「归属于某机构」的权力。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a person settled in one house and staying there.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个人在一栋房子里安顿下来并长住。

branches.en: Living in a place is the core physical sense.
branches.cn: 在某地居住，是核心物理义项。

branches.en: A quality lives inside what shows it.
branches.cn: 性质住在展现它的东西里面。

branches.en: Power belongs to the body that holds it.
branches.cn: 权力归属于掌握它的机构。

branches.en: A person resides in a house, and a value resides in a plan.
branches.cn: 人住在房子里，价值住在计划里。

branches.en: Both qualities and powers are pictured as dwelling somewhere.
branches.cn: 性质与权力都被想象成「住在某处」。

intro.en: Reside is a Latin verb carried through French, with English endings forming its noun and adjective family.
intro.cn: reside 是经法语传递的拉丁动词，名词与形容词词族由英语词尾构成。

latinIntro.en: Latin sedere means to sit, and residere means to remain behind or settle.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 sedere 意为坐，residere 意为留下、定居。

items.example: Re- adds the sense of remaining.
Residere joins the prefix and the root.
items.exampleCN: residere 把前缀与词根结合。

items.example: Resider carries the verb into French.
items.exampleCN: resider 把这个动词带入法语。

items.meaningCN: 表示状态或动作的词尾

definition_zh: 愉快地；爽快地
definition_en: in a happy and bright way, or willingly and without complaint
core_image: 一边搬东西一边哼歌的人
scene: 雨下了一整天，店里却没人抱怨。 The staff cheerfully carried the boxes up the stairs in the rain.
sceneCN: 这里 cheerfully 指「愉快地」（第 1 个义项：以快乐明朗的方式做事）；句意是员工们冒雨把箱子愉快地搬上楼。

derivatives.zh: 快乐的；开朗的
开朗；愉快
欢呼；使振奋

senses.title: In a happy manner
senses.definition: in a way that shows a bright and happy mood
senses.definitionCN: 以显出明朗快乐情绪的方式
senses.example: She cheerfully waved at the children.
senses.exampleCN: 她愉快地朝孩子们挥手。
senses.why: The adverb adds -ly to cheerful, so the bright manner of the adjective becomes the manner of an action.
senses.whyCN: 副词在 cheerful 后加 -ly，形容词的明朗神情便成了动作的方式。

senses.title: Willingly and without complaint
senses.definition: readily and with good humour, even when the task is hard
senses.definitionCN: 即使任务艰难也乐意而带着好心情地做
senses.example: He cheerfully took the night shift for a sick colleague.
senses.exampleCN: 他爽快地替生病的同事上了夜班。
senses.why: A bright face also signals consent, so the adverb came to mean willing agreement.
senses.whyCN: 明朗的神情也传递应允，因此这个副词也表示乐意同意。

intro.en: Cheerfully is cheerful plus the native adverb ending -ly.
intro.cn: cheerfully 是 cheerful 加上本土副词词尾 -ly。

items.en: Cara named the face.
items.cn: 拉丁语 cara 指脸。

items.en: Chiere meant the expression worn on a face.
items.cn: 古法语 chiere 指脸上带着的神情。

items.en: Cheer named the face and its look.
items.cn: 英语 cheer 指脸及其神情。

items.en: Cheerful added -ful, and -ly then turned it into an adverb.
items.cn: cheerful 加上 -ful，副词词尾 -ly 再把它变成副词。

items.en: Cheerfully now covers both a happy manner and willing consent.
items.cn: 如今 cheerfully 既指愉快的方式，也指乐意的应允。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the cheer stem, while the meaning group lists adverbs of glad consent.
note.cn: 形近组共享 cheer 词干，近义组列出表示乐意与高兴的副词。

entries.definition: in a pleased and contented way

normalIntro.en: These hooks unpack the three pieces cheerful, -ful and -ly, then link the willing sense.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子拆开 cheerful、-ful 与 -ly 三段，再联系「乐意」的义项。

normal.en: Cheerfully is a three-storey word: cheer, then -ful, then -ly.
normal.cn: cheerfully 是三层楼：先 cheer，再 -ful，最后 -ly。

normal.en: The adverb answers how: how did she answer? She answered cheerfully.
normal.cn: 这个副词回答「怎样」：她怎样回答？她愉快地回答。

normal.en: Cheerfully before a verb often hints at willingness, as in cheerfully agree.
normal.cn: cheerfully 放在动词前常暗示乐意，如 cheerfully agree。

normal.en: Drop -ly and you are back to the adjective cheerful.
normal.cn: 去掉 -ly，就回到形容词 cheerful。

normal.en: The opposite manner is described by cheerlessly, a rare but regular form.
normal.cn: 相反的方式可用 cheerlessly 描述，虽少见但合乎构词规则。

abstract.en: Picture a worker carrying two heavy boxes and still humming.
abstract.cn: 想象一个工人抱着两只重箱子还在哼歌。

abstract.en: Picture a nurse answering a night bell with a smile.
abstract.cn: 想象护士带着微笑回应夜里的呼叫铃。

abstract.en: Picture rain running off a coat while its owner laughs.
abstract.cn: 想象雨水从外套上流下，而穿外套的人却在笑。

examples.en: The children cheerfully sang the whole way home.
examples.cn: 孩子们一路愉快地唱着歌回家。

examples.en: She cheerfully agreed to show us around.
examples.cn: 她爽快地答应带我们四处看看。

examples.en: He cheerfully admitted that the plan had failed.
examples.cn: 他坦然地承认计划失败了。

dict_mnemonic.text: cheerful 加 -ly：一张满脸是笑的脸做出来的动作，就是愉快地。

root: 由形容词 cheerful（cheer 脸、神情，加 -ful 充满）再加副词后缀 -ly 构成。

sensesIntro.en: The adverb first describes a happy manner, and then that bright face is read as willing consent.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个副词先描述愉快的方式，随后那副明朗神情被理解为乐意的应允。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a smile carried into a task that is not easy.
core.cn: 核心意象：把笑容带进一件并不轻松的任务里。

branches.en: The adverb describes how someone smiles or sings.
branches.cn: 这个副词描述某人怎样微笑或唱歌。

branches.en: The same form marks ready agreement to a hard task.
branches.cn: 同一形式标记出对艰难任务的欣然接受。

branches.en: It usually sits after the verb or before the verb phrase.
branches.cn: 它通常放在动词后或动词短语前。

branches.en: Both senses carry the same outward brightness.
branches.cn: 两个义项都带着同一种外露的明亮。

branches.en: A cheerful yes is a promise without complaint.
branches.cn: 一个愉快的「好」就是不带抱怨的承诺。

intro.en: Cheerfully stacks a root, a suffix and an adverb ending in a single word.
intro.cn: cheerfully 在一个词里叠起词根、后缀与副词词尾。

latinIntro.en: The root reaches Latin cara, a face, through Old French chiere.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词根经古法语 chiere 上溯拉丁语 cara，意为脸。

items.meaning: in a bright and willing way

latinEntries.example: Cara is the oldest layer of the stem.
latinEntries.exampleCN: cara 是这个词干最古老的一层。

latinEntries.example: Chiere gave English the word cheer.
latinEntries.exampleCN: chiere 给英语提供了 cheer 这个词。

definition_zh: 罐子；广口瓶；一罐之量；（使）发出刺耳声；震动；不协调
definition_en: a glass pot with a wide mouth for storing food, the amount it holds, or to make a harsh sound or shock
core_image: 一只广口的玻璃罐，罐底还剩一层蜜，盖子歪着
scene: 厨房架子上摆着几只玻璃罐，阳光透过罐壁照出一圈亮边。 She kept the honey in a glass jar on the top shelf.
sceneCN: 这里 jar 是「罐子」（第 1 个义项：广口玻璃容器），句意为她把蜂蜜装在上层架子的一只玻璃罐里。画面里的物件：玻璃罐、架子、阳光。

pos.zh: 名词：罐子；广口瓶；一罐之量
动词：发出刺耳声；不协调

derivatives.zh: 复数形式，义为「多个罐子」
由 jar 加 -ful 构成，义为「一罐之量」
由动词加 -ing 构成，义为「刺耳的；令人不安的」

senses.title: A wide-mouthed container
senses.definition: a round glass or clay container with a wide mouth, used for storing food
senses.definitionCN: 圆形的玻璃或陶制广口容器，用来存放食物
senses.example: There is an empty jar on the shelf.
senses.exampleCN: 架子上有一只空罐子。
senses.why: The container sense is a later application of an older word for a ewer, a water pot.
senses.whyCN: 容器义是这个词更早的「水罐」义的后起用法。

senses.title: The amount it holds
senses.definition: the contents of a jar or the quantity needed to fill one
senses.definitionCN: 一个罐子所装的东西或装满一罐的量
senses.example: He ate a whole jar of olives.
senses.exampleCN: 他吃了一整罐橄榄。
senses.why: English often lets a container stand for its contents, so jar means a jarful.
senses.whyCN: 英语常用容器代指内容物，于是 jar 也可以表示一罐之量。

senses.title: To make a harsh sound
senses.definition: to make or cause an unpleasant, harsh noise by striking or grinding
senses.definitionCN: 撞击或摩擦而发出难听刺耳的声音
senses.example: The metal door jarred against its frame.
senses.exampleCN: 金属门撞在门框上发出一声刺响。
senses.why: This verb comes from a different echo of the same onomatopoeic idea, a sharp knock.
senses.whyCN: 这个动词来自同一拟声想法的另一种回响，是一次尖利的撞碰。

senses.title: To shake physically
senses.definition: to give something a sudden shock or violent shake
senses.definitionCN: 给某物突然的冲击或猛烈震动
senses.example: The fall jarred his shoulder badly.
senses.exampleCN: 这一跤重重震到了他的肩膀。
senses.why: A jarring impact is a knock serious enough to be felt through the body.
senses.whyCN: 震人的冲击就是一下能透过身体感觉到的撞。

senses.title: To be out of harmony
senses.definition: to be or seem unpleasant and out of place with the surroundings
senses.definitionCN: 与周围环境格格不入、令人不适
senses.example: The bright red chair jars with the quiet room.
senses.exampleCN: 那张鲜红的椅子与安静的房间很不协调。
senses.why: A harsh sound in a soft place is the metaphor behind this social sense.
senses.whyCN: 柔和之处的一声刺响，正是这个比喻义的底子。

intro.en: Jar for a container came through French jarre from Arabic jarrah, while the verb of knocking is an English imitation of a harsh sound.
intro.cn: 表示容器的 jar 经法语 jarre 来自阿拉伯语 jarrah；表示撞响的动词则是英语对刺耳声音的模仿。

items.en: jarrah named a large earthen water pot.
items.cn: jarrah 指大的陶制水罐。

items.en: Spanish jarra and jarro carried the word in the same sense.
items.cn: 西班牙语 jarra、jarro 带着同样的意义流传。

items.en: Old French jarre meant a jar or ewer.
items.cn: 古法语 jarre 意为罐、水壶。

items.en: English borrowed jar for a clay or glass vessel.
items.cn: 英语借入 jar，指陶制或玻璃容器。

items.en: The verb jar, to knock or grate, developed separately.
items.cn: 表示撞击、摩擦出声的动词 jar 是另外发展的。

note.en: The look-alike group is the jar- family; the near-meaning group holds containers and harsh sounds.
note.cn: 形近组是 jar- 词族；近义组收容器与刺耳声相关词。

entries.definitionCN: 由本词加 -ful 构成，义为「一罐之量」。
复数形式，义为「多个罐子」，同族。

entries.definition: Harsh and unpleasant to hear or see.
entries.definitionCN: 由动词加 -ing 构成，义为「刺耳的；令人不安的」。

entries.definition: A container for liquids with a handle and a lip.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「壶」，带把手和倒口。
名词义为「罐头」，材质是金属。

normalIntro.en: These hooks deal with the two histories together: the Arabic pot and the English harsh knock.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子把两条历史放在一起：阿拉伯语的罐子与英语的刺耳撞击声。

normal.en: Arabic jarrah was a big water pot.
normal.cn: 阿拉伯语 jarrah 是大的水罐。

normal.en: French jarre and Spanish jarra are cousins.
normal.cn: 法语 jarre 与西班牙语 jarra 是它的亲属。

normal.en: A jarful is the amount one jar holds.
normal.cn: jarful 就是一罐的量。

normal.en: The door jarred against the frame with a bang.
normal.cn: 门在门框上砰地一撞。

normal.en: White walls and a red chair jar with each other.
normal.cn: 白墙和红椅子彼此不协调。

abstract.en: A jar holds something in a round glass body.
abstract.cn: 罐子用圆鼓的玻璃身体把东西装住。

abstract.en: A jarring sound is a noise that refuses to fit.
abstract.cn: 刺耳声是一种拒绝合拍的噪声。

abstract.en: What jars cannot settle into the room around it.
abstract.cn: 不协调的东西安不进周围的房间。

examples.en: Put the pickles in a clean jar.
examples.cn: 把泡菜放进一只干净的罐子。

examples.en: The sudden noise jarred her awake.
examples.cn: 突然的响声把她震醒了。

examples.en: His joke jarred with the serious mood.
examples.cn: 他的笑话与严肃的气氛很不协调。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「扎」—— 玻璃罐没接住，扎在地上咣一声

root: 阿拉伯语 jarrah「大陶水罐」→ 西班牙语 jarra → 古法语 jarre → 英语 jar「罐子」；动词「撞响、不协调」为英语另行发展。同族有 jarful、jarring。

sensesIntro.en: Five senses: a wide container, the amount inside, a harsh sound, a physical shake, and being out of harmony.
sensesIntro.cn: 五个义项：广口容器、一罐之量、刺耳声、身体震动，以及与周围不协调。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a wide glass jar, honey at the bottom, its lid askew.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只广口玻璃罐，罐底有蜜，盖子歪着。

branches.en: THE SHELF: morning light through a glass wall.
branches.cn: 架子这条线：晨光透过玻璃壁。

branches.en: THE OLIVES: one whole jar eaten at once.
branches.cn: 橄榄这条线：一次吃完一整罐。

branches.en: THE DOOR: metal grinding on a frame.
branches.cn: 门这条线：金属蹭过门框。

branches.en: THE FALL: a shock felt through the shoulder.
branches.cn: 摔倒这条线：从肩膀透上来的冲击。

branches.en: THE ROOM: a red chair that does not belong.
branches.cn: 房间这条线：格格不入的红椅子。

intro.en: Jar as a container is a borrowing reshaped in English; the endings below are English or Arabic-French spellings.
intro.cn: 表示容器的 jar 是借词在英语里定型；下面的成分包括英语词尾与阿拉伯—法语拼写。

latinIntro.en: The container word travelled through Arabic and Spanish, not Latin; there is no Latin entry for it.
latinIntro.cn: 表示容器的这个词经阿拉伯语和西班牙语传来，不经过拉丁语，因此没有拉丁条目。

items.example: The Spanish form of the word.
items.exampleCN: 这个词的西班牙语形式。

items.example: It comes from the verb jar.
The base noun of the entry.

definition_zh: 连接（connection 的旧式英式拼法）；联系
definition_en: an older British spelling of connection, still kept in some names
core_image: 旧书页上的铅字，比现在的拼法多一个字母 x
scene: 老图书馆的书脊上仍印着旧式拼法。 The old journal kept the spelling connexion on every page.
sceneCN: 这里 connexion 指「旧式拼法」（第 1 个义项：connection 较早的英式写法）；句意是那本旧期刊每一页都沿用这种拼法。

collocations.zh: 两者之间的联系（旧式拼写）

derivatives.zh: 连接；联系
连接；联系（现代标准拼法）
联会的；教会联合体的

senses.title: The old spelling
senses.definition: the older British way of writing connection
senses.definitionCN: connection 在英国较早的写法
senses.example: The word connexion appears in old books.
senses.exampleCN: connexion 这个词出现在旧书里。
senses.why: Spelling is a habit, and habits change slowly over centuries.
senses.whyCN: 拼写是一种习惯，而习惯要几个世纪才慢慢改变。

senses.title: Still in names
senses.definition: the spelling kept today in some churches and institutions
senses.definitionCN: 如今仍保留在某些教会与机构名称中的写法
senses.example: The church still calls itself a connexion.
senses.exampleCN: 这个教会仍把自己称作联会。
senses.why: A name outlives the fashion that once produced it.
senses.whyCN: 一个名字会比产生它的时尚活得更久。

senses.title: A joining in meaning
senses.definition: the same meaning as connection, namely a link or a relationship
senses.definitionCN: 与 connection 含义相同，指连接或关系
senses.example: Their connexion to the port was never proved.
senses.exampleCN: 他们与这个港口的联系从未得到证实。
senses.why: A different letter does not change the thing the word points at.
senses.whyCN: 换一个字母，并不改变这个词所指的东西。

intro.en: Connexion comes from Latin connexio, the noun of connectere, and preserves the x of the Latin participle connexus.
intro.cn: connexion 来自拉丁语 connexio，即 connectere 的名词形式，保留了拉丁语分词 connexus 里的 x。

items.en: Connectere meant to bind together, with participle connexus.
items.cn: connectere 意为绑在一起，其分词是 connexus。

items.en: Connexio kept the x of that participle in the noun.
items.cn: 名词 connexio 保留了分词中的 x。

items.en: French connexion passed the x spelling to English.
items.cn: 法语 connexion 把带 x 的拼法传给英语。

items.en: English used connexion as the normal form for centuries.
items.cn: 英语在几个世纪里都把 connexion 当作常规写法。

items.en: A reform favoured connection to match the Latin verb stem.
items.cn: 一场拼写改革倾向用 connection，以贴合拉丁动词词干。

items.en: Connexion now survives mainly in old texts and institution names.
items.cn: 如今 connexion 主要存留在旧文本与机构名称中。

note.en: The look-alike group holds near neighbours in spelling, and the meaning group lists the modern word and other links.
note.cn: 形近组收的是拼写上的近邻，近义组列出对应的现代写法与其它表示联系的说法。

entries.definition: relating to a union of churches
the natural colour of a person's skin
something that holds two sides together
entries.definitionCN: 把两方系在一起的纽带

normalIntro.en: These hooks start from the letter x in old print, then move to the institutions that kept it and to the meaning that never changed.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从旧印刷品里的字母 x 开始，再到保留它的机构，最后到从未改变的含义。

normal.en: Think of the x as a cross stitch holding two edges of cloth.
normal.cn: 把 x 想成一道十字针脚，把两块布边缝在一起。

normal.en: Old books loved x, so connexio turned into connexion.
normal.cn: 旧书偏爱 x，于是 connexio 变成了 connexion。

normal.en: The ct spelling won, but some churches kept the x.
normal.cn: ct 拼法胜出，但有些教会仍留着 x。

normal.en: Change one letter and the meaning still stands.
normal.cn: 只换一个字母，含义依然不变。

normal.en: If a name is old, expect an x in it.
normal.cn: 若名字很老，就等着里面出现一个 x。

abstract.en: Picture an x stitched into the spine of a book.
abstract.cn: 想象一个 x 被缝在书脊上。

abstract.en: Picture a brass plate with old letters on a church door.
abstract.cn: 想象教堂门上一块刻着旧字体的铜牌。

abstract.en: Picture two spellings standing side by side, pointing at one meaning.
abstract.cn: 想象两种拼法并排站着，指向同一个意思。

examples.en: The nineteenth century text uses connexion throughout.
examples.cn: 这本十九世纪的文本通篇用 connexion。

examples.en: She wrote in connexion with the missing letters.
examples.cn: 她就那些丢失的信件写信联系。

examples.en: The old society still signs its letters with connexion.
examples.cn: 这个老社团仍在信末用 connexion 署名。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 connexion 记成 connection 的老照片：意思一样，只是把 ct 写成 x，多见于旧书与教会名称。

root: 源自拉丁语 connexio（connectere 的名词，分词为 connexus），本是连接之义，英语保留了 x 的旧式拼法。

sensesIntro.en: From a letter kept from Latin, to the institutions that still print it, and back to the plain meaning of a link.
sensesIntro.cn: 从拉丁语留下的一个字母，到至今仍这样印的机构，最后回到联系这个朴素含义。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one old letter x holding two halves of the same word.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个古老的字母 x，撑着同一个词的两半。

branches.en: The first sense is purely a matter of spelling history.
branches.cn: 第一个义项纯粹是拼写史的问题。

branches.en: Institutions keep the old form as part of their identity.
branches.cn: 机构把这种旧写法当作身份的一部分保留下来。

branches.en: Whatever the spelling, the meaning stays a link.
branches.cn: 无论怎么拼，含义始终是一个联系。

branches.en: Two spellings and one meaning: the word never split in two.
branches.cn: 两种拼法一个含义：这个词从未裂成两个。

branches.en: A church connexion is a union of people, not a spelling lesson.
branches.cn: 教会的联会指的是人的联合，而不是拼写课。

intro.en: Connexion is the older form of connection, built on Latin com-, together, plus nectere, to bind.
intro.cn: connexion 是 connection 的旧式写法，由拉丁语 com-（一起）与 nectere（系绑）构成。

latinIntro.en: The Latin participle connexus explains the x, while the same base appears in nexus and annex.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语分词 connexus 解释了这里的 x，而同一词基也出现在 nexus 与 annex 中。

items.example: The index lists connexion under c.
items.exampleCN: 索引把 connexion 排在 c 字母下。
少了一个起连接作用的词。

items.example: This connector fits the old port.
items.exampleCN: 这个接头适合那个旧接口。

items.example: Trade was the nexus of the town.
items.exampleCN: 贸易是这座城镇的纽带。

definition_zh: 行李；包袱；精神负担
definition_en: the bags and cases a traveller carries, or something heavy that weighs on the mind
core_image: 传送带上缓缓转来一只贴满标签的旧箱子
scene: 机场的转盘一直没有停。 We waited by the belt for our baggage.
sceneCN: 这里 baggage 是「行李」（第 1 个义项：旅行时携带的箱包总称）；句意是我们在传送带旁等自己的行李。

derivatives.zh: 同源基础词，义为「包；袋子」，baggage 由其加 -age 构成
由 bag 加 -ful 构成，义为「一袋之量」
由 bag 加 -y 构成，义为「宽松的」

senses.title: Luggage
senses.definition: the bags and cases that a traveller carries
senses.definitionCN: 旅行者携带的箱包总称
senses.example: We waited by the belt for our baggage.
senses.exampleCN: 我们在传送带旁等自己的行李。
senses.why: Baggage came from Old French bagage, a bundle of goods, so it named the whole load rather than one bag.
senses.whyCN: baggage 来自古法语 bagage「一捆货物」，所以它指的是整批行装，而不是单个包。

senses.title: Emotional burden
senses.definition: past experiences or feelings that weigh on a person
senses.definitionCN: 压在心上的过往经历或情绪
senses.example: She carried a lot of emotional baggage from her childhood.
senses.exampleCN: 她背负着许多来自童年的情感包袱。
senses.why: Because baggage is a heavy load you carry along, the word was borrowed for troubles a person drags through life.
senses.whyCN: 因为行李是随身携带的重负，这个词就被借来指人一路拖着走的心事。

intro.en: Baggage came into English from French, where it meant a bundle of goods.
intro.cn: baggage 经法语进入英语，原义是「一捆货物」。

items.en: bagage meant 'a bundle of goods'.
items.cn: bagage 意为「一捆货物」。

items.en: English took the word for a traveller's packs.
items.cn: 英语借入该词，指旅人的行装。

items.en: baggage covered military and travel loads.
items.cn: baggage 涵盖军队与旅行的装备。

items.en: the word settled as an uncountable noun.
items.cn: 这个词固定为不可数名词。

items.en: emotional baggage is now a common phrase.
items.cn: 如今 emotional baggage 是常见说法。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the bag- root; the near-meaning group names the bags of travel.
note.cn: 形近组共享 bag 词根；近义组是旅行箱包的说法。

entries.definition: a soft container for carrying things
as much as a bag holds
a case for clothes when travelling

normalIntro.en: Baggage is the whole load you carry, not one bag.
normalIntro.cn: baggage 指随身带的整批行装，而不是单个包。

normal.en: Baggage is uncountable, so say a piece of baggage.
normal.cn: baggage 不可数，要说 a piece of baggage。

normal.en: Baggage claim is where you collect your bags.
normal.cn: baggage claim 是取行李的地方。

normal.en: Excess baggage costs extra at the airport.
normal.cn: 超重行李在机场要额外收费。

normal.en: The word ends in -age, like luggage.
normal.cn: 这个词以 -age 结尾，和 luggage 一样。

normal.en: Emotional baggage means old troubles.
normal.cn: emotional baggage 指旧日的心事。

abstract.en: See a worn case circling on a belt.
abstract.cn: 想象一只旧箱子在传送带上一圈圈转。

abstract.en: See a pile of packs roped together.
abstract.cn: 想象一捆用绳扎起的包裹。

abstract.en: See a traveller dragging a heavy load.
abstract.cn: 想象一名旅客拖着沉重的行装。

examples.en: We waited by the belt for our baggage.
examples.cn: 我们在传送带旁等自己的行李。

examples.en: She carried a lot of emotional baggage from her childhood.
examples.cn: 她背负着许多来自童年的情感包袱。

examples.en: The airline lost his baggage on the way home.
examples.cn: 航空公司在他回家的路上弄丢了他的行李。

dict_mnemonic.text: bag 是包，加 -age 表示集合：许多包捆在一起，就是 baggage 行李。

root: 来自古法语 bagage「一捆货物」，与 bag 同源；进入英语后指旅人的全部行装，因不可数而常说 a piece of baggage，近代又引申为「精神包袱」。

sensesIntro.en: The whole load a traveller carries and the weight a person carries inside share one word.
sensesIntro.cn: 旅人随身带的整批行装，与人心里背负的重量，共用一个词。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a worn case circling on a belt.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只旧箱子在传送带上转圈。

branches.en: checked baggage
branches.cn: 托运行李

branches.en: baggage claim
branches.cn: 行李提取处

branches.en: excess baggage
branches.cn: 超重行李

branches.en: emotional baggage
branches.cn: 情感包袱

branches.en: carry old baggage
branches.cn: 背着旧日包袱

intro.en: The -age suffix turns bag into a collective noun for all the bags.
intro.cn: 后缀 -age 把 bag 变成表示全部行李的集合名词。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin base; the word came from Old French bagage.
latinIntro.cn: 这里没有拉丁词基，这个词来自古法语 bagage。

items.meaning: all the bags of a traveller
as much as a bag holds

definition_zh: 用法；使用；惯用法；用量；消耗量
definition_en: the way words are used, or the act or amount of using something
core_image: 同一把工具，被用得越来越顺手
scene: 老师把两种说法写在黑板上，说后者在正式文章里更常见。 This usage is common in spoken English but rare in writing.
sceneCN: 这里 usage 是「用法」（第 1 个义项：词语使用的方式与惯例）；句意为这种用法在口语中常见，书面里少见。同一把工具越用越顺手的画面，正是这个词的核心。

derivatives.zh: 去掉名词词尾 -age 后的基础形式，义为「使用」
由 use 加 -able 构成，义为「可用的」
由 use 加 -less 构成，义为「无用的」
同源形容词，义为「通常的」

senses.title: The way a word is used
senses.definition: the way in which a word or phrase is actually used
senses.definitionCN: 词语或短语实际被使用的方式
senses.example: The dictionary records many modern usages.
senses.exampleCN: 这部词典收录了许多现代用法。
senses.why: The word starts from the plain act of using, and in language that act settles into patterns.
senses.whyCN: 这个词从「使用」这个朴素行为出发，而在语言里这种行为会沉淀成模式。

senses.title: Established custom in language
senses.definition: the custom that a group of speakers follows
senses.definitionCN: 一群人说话行文所遵循的惯例
senses.example: By common usage the title is shortened to one word.
senses.exampleCN: 按通行用法，这个名称缩成了一词。
senses.why: Repeated use by many speakers hardens into custom, and the abstract sense follows easily.
senses.whyCN: 很多人反复使用便会固化成惯例，抽象义便是这样自然生出。

senses.title: The act of using something
senses.definition: the act or practice of employing something
senses.definitionCN: 使用某物的行为或做法
senses.example: The usage of the hall is limited to members.
senses.exampleCN: 这个大厅的使用仅限会员。
senses.why: Strip away the patterns and what remains is the bare act the noun was first made for.
senses.whyCN: 把那些套路剥掉，剩下的正是这个词最初用来表示的那个单纯动作。

senses.title: The amount used
senses.definition: the quantity of something consumed over time
senses.definitionCN: 在一段时间内消耗的数量
senses.example: Energy usage drops in the warmer months.
senses.exampleCN: 天气暖和的月份能耗下降。
senses.why: If use has a size, it can be measured, and a meter turns the act into a figure.
senses.whyCN: 使用如果有大小就可以计量，而水表电表把这个动作变成了一个数字。

senses.title: A long-standing custom in law or trade
senses.definition: a practice that has become accepted in law or trade
senses.definitionCN: 在法律或行业中已被接受的做法
senses.example: The old usage of the port allowed boats to moor free.
senses.exampleCN: 港口的旧惯例允许船只免费停泊。
senses.why: The same hardening of practice that gives language its habits gives trades and courts theirs.
senses.whyCN: 让语言形成习惯的那种固化过程，也同样让行业与法庭形成惯例。

intro.en: A French noun formed on the Latin word for use, with the common suffix of action.
intro.cn: 一个以拉丁语「使用」为底、加常见行为词尾构成的法语名词。

items.en: Usus meant use or practice, from the verb uti.
items.cn: usus 意为「使用、实践」，出自动词 uti。

items.en: Usage in the sense of custom grew from usus as practice rather than single act.
items.cn: 「惯例」义由 usus 的「实践」义发展而来，而非单次行为。

items.en: Usage entered French as the noun of using and of custom.
items.cn: usage 在法语中作名词，兼指使用与惯例。

items.en: Usage enters English in the fourteenth century with both senses.
items.cn: usage 于十四世纪进入英语，两层意思同时带入。

items.en: In the twentieth century it takes the technical sense of amount consumed.
items.cn: 到二十世纪，它又获得「消耗量」这一技术性含义。

note.en: The look-alike group follows the use family, while the near-meaning group collects words about practice and consumption.
note.cn: 形近组沿 use 词族展开，近义组汇集表示惯例与消耗的词。

entries.definition: a usual way of doing things
an agreed way of doing things

normalIntro.en: A noun built on use with the same suffix as voyage and marriage.
normalIntro.cn: 一个由 use 加名词词尾构成的词，这个词尾也见于 voyage 与 marriage。

normal.en: Use plus -age makes the noun of the doing and of the amount done.
normal.cn: use 加 -age 构成表示「做的行为」与「做的量」的名词。

normal.en: English usage means the customary way words are used.
normal.cn: English usage 指词语惯用的方式。

normal.en: Water usage and energy usage are the amount senses.
normal.cn: water usage 与 energy usage 是「用量」义。

normal.en: Usual and usage look alike but one is an adjective.
normal.cn: usual 与 usage 形近，但前者是形容词。

normal.en: Usage is neutral; misuse is the wrong use of it.
normal.cn: usage 中性，misuse 指把用法用错。

abstract.en: Watch a tool grow smoother in the same pair of hands.
abstract.cn: 看同一双手里的工具越用越顺手。

abstract.en: See two spellings side by side and one slowly win.
abstract.cn: 看两种拼法并列，其中一种慢慢胜出。

abstract.en: Notice a tap left running and a meter turning.
abstract.cn: 注意开着的水龙头与转动的水表。

examples.en: The book explains the usage of common prepositions.
examples.cn: 这本书讲解常见介词的用法。

examples.en: Water usage fell sharply after the new rules.
examples.cn: 新规实施后，用水量明显下降。

examples.en: In formal usage the title is written in full.
examples.cn: 按正式惯用法，这个名称要写全。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「尤赛吉」——尤赛吉家那把老剪刀人人抢着用，用出来的花样就是它的用法。

root: 古法语 usage，源自晚期拉丁 usaticum，再往上为拉丁 usus / uti（使用、实践），名词词尾 -age 表行为或状态

sensesIntro.en: One noun for the practice of using covers word habits, plain employment, amount consumed, and legal custom.
sensesIntro.cn: 一个表示「使用」的名词，覆盖词语习惯、一般使用、消耗数量与法律惯例。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a tool worn smooth by the same hands.
core.cn: 核心意象：被同一双手用得发亮的工具。

branches.en: The language branch: how a word actually behaves.
branches.cn: 语言分支：一个词实际怎样使用。

branches.en: The custom branch: what a group has settled on.
branches.cn: 惯例分支：一群人定下来的说法。

branches.en: The plain branch: the bare act of employing.
branches.cn: 一般分支：单纯的使用行为。

branches.en: The meter branch: what goes into the water bill.
branches.cn: 计量分支：写进水费账单的部分。

branches.en: The law branch: a habit recognised by courts.
branches.cn: 法律分支：被法庭认可的习惯。

intro.en: A Latin root of using with the French noun suffix that also made voyage.
intro.cn: 一个表示「使用」的拉丁词根，配上同样造就 voyage 的法语名词词尾。

latinIntro.en: The Latin base is uti and its noun usus, with usaticum behind the French form.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁底子是 uti 与其名词 usus，法语形式背后有 usaticum。

items.example: That is a misuse of funds.
